name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
description: Pick exactly one option from a short row, shown as joined segments.
a11y: A named radio group; arrow keys move and select, Home and End jump.
One option is always selected: pressing the active one does nothing.

props.name: options
props.description: The segments to show, each with a `value`, a `label` and an optional `disabled`.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected segment's `value` when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The segment selected at first when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first option.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new segment's `value` when the user picks a different one.
